routes.name: No Name
routes.desc: Steep boulder problem in the cave marked 'V10'.

routes.name: Genesis
routes.desc: The leftmost route on this crag. Also the only one that continues past the lip of the roof and up the leaning headwall, all the way to the jungle. Not rebolted with titanium, 9 stainless steel glue-ins, 2 slings.
routes.setter: Björn Alber, Nantawan Alber & Henrik Bolander, 2010
warnings: Fixed Gear: Not rebolted with titanium, 9 stainless steel glue-ins, 2 slings.

routes.name: Tough Trip Through Paradise
routes.desc: Warning Fixed Gear: Ware on sling Climbs the short roof a few meters right of 'Genesis' to an anchor just above the lip. 4 titanium bolts, 1 sling. There seems to be the option of doing linkups via the rail 1-2 m before the lip.

routes.name: Khun Bar
routes.desc: Two meters left of 'Black Diamond'. Bouldery. Titanium bolts.

routes.name: Black Diamond
routes.desc: Dyno crux on the steep black rock a few meters left of 'Little Shit'. Always wet and slimy, impossible to climb after rain. Titanium bolts.

routes.name: Little Shit
routes.desc: The lefthand 6c taking a rail/flake for the steepest bit. Reportedly not very good, but with this grade and location it was always going to get heaps of traffic. Shares anchors with 'Princess Eyes'. All titanium bolts.

routes.name: Princess Eyes
routes.desc: The righthand 6c, this time getting through the steep bit on fingery pockets. This one is also supposed to be pretty average. Shares anchors with 'Little Shit'. Titanium bolts.

routes.name: Titanium from Hell / Tales of Power
routes.desc: Just left behind the tufa hanging down to 2m off the sand. Juggy rail to some tricky moves around the bulge then stem up the left side of the hanging tufa system. All titanium bolts. Originally named 'Tales of Power' at grade 7c. Rebolted a little further right to an easier line. Some guidebooks kept the original name.

routes.name: Don't Buy Toys
routes.desc: Pockety steep start into the big huecos, then up the right side of the tufa system. The 4th bolt is actually on the side of the tufa. All titanium bolts.

routes.name: New Way
routes.desc: Linkup. Shares the start with 'Don't Buy Toys', then continue right into 'Mekong Haze' after the 3rd bolt. Titanium bolts.

routes.name: Mekong Haze
routes.desc: Just right of 'Don't Buy Toys'. Bit of a squeeze but looks great! All titanium bolts.

routes.name: Might as Well Hurl
routes.desc: Right of 'Mekong Haze'. Awesome moves! A short draw or single carabiner on the 2nd bolt is good at softening the swing back onto the belayer's rope for falls off the first crux. All titanium bolts.

routes.name: Up to You
routes.desc: The righmost route on the eye-catching pocketed section of rock, and possibly the best here. Shares the start with 'Half Dragon' and 'Hot Dragon'. All titanium bolts.

routes.name: Half Dragon
routes.desc: Righthand finish variation of 'Up to You'. Veers right before the last bolt to a separate anchor a bit higher up. 30 degrees the whole way. All titanium bolts. The original line was called 'Hot Dragon' and continued up right for another 5m at 8b grade. The old bolts have been chopped and the new shorter and easier route was called 'Half Dragon'. Some guidebooks kept the original name though.
warnings: Fixed Gear: The old bolts have been chopped and the new shorter and easier route was called 'Half Dragon'.

routes.name: Hot Dragon
routes.desc: Closed Original line that was recycled into 'Half Dragon'. The old bolts have been chopped.
warnings: Fixed Gear: The old bolts have been chopped.

routes.name: Left of Cleft
routes.desc: Subtract 2 grades if your span is 190cm+, or add two grades if it's less! Lovely rock, cool moves, all ruined by the last move. Over the bulge, then climb the easy cleft for 8m onto the steep wall just left of the cleft. 7 titanium bolts, 2 slings. Some guidebooks list this route as 'No Name'.

routes.name: Em & Ems
routes.desc: Just right of the cleft, the leftmost line on the Money Maker pillar. Slightly grungy black rock at times. Grade varies between 5 and 6a in different guidebooks. The fixed hangers are shiny, but beware.

routes.name: Lak Kai
routes.desc: Just left of 'Money Maker'. Grade varies between 5 and 6a in different guidebooks. Titanium bolts and slings. Bolt plate missing before anchors, long run out and slings have seen better days.

routes.name: Money Maker
routes.desc: Start on the left side of the Money Maker pillar and go straight up. Top half is nice and delicate. 4 titanium bolts, 1 sling.

routes.name: Phra-Nang Princess
routes.desc: Shares the start with 'Money Maker', then trend right. Titanium bolts. Originally this route was a 90m multi-pitch. Only the first pitch was rebolted and now carries the name.

routes.name: Small Change
routes.desc: Start on the front of the column, then straight up into 'Phra-Nang Princess'.

routes.name: Back To Mani / Cave
routes.desc: Steepish start up the corner on the right side of the pillar. Finish inside a cave. 1 titanium bolt, 4 slings.

routes.name: Top-Roped
routes.desc: Climbs uo right of 'Back to Mani', all the way to the top of the pillar, sharing anchor with 'Money Maker'. No bolts, climb toprope.

routes.name: Fertilite / Princess Cave
routes.desc: Starts in the corner right of the Money Maker pillar and climbs up right onto the face. All titanium bolts. The original line was one of the first routes on the Phra-Nang peninsula and climbed on further right for a total length of 35m. However, due to the proximity to the Princess Cave and the many tourists below on the beach, only the first half has been rebolted and the original bolts have been chopped.
routes.setter: Thierry Renault, Marlie Walsh & Kurt Albert †, 1989
